newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Restaurant Brands set at NZ$2.20 a share.
newsitem.headline: Restaurant Brands set at NZ$2.20 a share.

text.p: Restaurant Brands New Zealand Ltd's issue price has been set at NZ$2.20 per share after an institutional tender, promoters of the issue said on Wednesday.
The issue price was at the top of the indicative NZ$1.80-$2.20 range.
Restaurant Brands, formed to take over the restaurant franchise operations of Pepsico Inc in New Zealand, is to list on the exchange at 9.30 a.m. (2130 GMT).
The offer was oversubscribed by about 300 percent with 85 million shares on offer and tenders received for about 338 million shares.
Gross proceeds would therefore be about NZ$187 million ($130 million).
As a result of the oversubscription, members of the New Zealand public who had not received firm allocations would be limited to a maximum of 1,000 shares each, the firm said.
Individual investors who applied for 1,000 or less shares would not be subject to scaling.
After allocation of shares, Restaurant Brands is expected to have about 15,000 shareholders with about 61 percent of its shares held by New Zealand retail and institutional investors.
Analysts had predicted that the isse would be well-supported by international investors with U.S.-based institutions expected to take a healthy interest in the new company.
